verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property office portal for filing and managing patents, trademarks and designs, not an automation or workflow platform, so scheduling recurring jobs is outside its category. 'Agendar atendimento' is a one-off appointment booking, not a recurring job schedule. Renewal periods and annuities are legal obligations, not product-run scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
